note: Paradigms of the nouns and verbs whose topic files give none (docs/lexicon.md §2.3). Nouns: seven cells per number, 1st case first; verbs: infinitive, present (a perfective verb: future) 1sg-3pl, imperative 2sg 1pl 2pl, l-participle by gender and number, and the future of the imperfective verbs that do not form it with budu. A cell is one form or variants, the preferred first.
